research_notes: Topic selected because not covered in existing hemle.blog reports; confirmed via full audit of 100+ existing slugs. AI Podcast Production is a distinct category from: ai-voice-agents (enterprise/customer service focus), ai-creator-tools (broader generalist), ai-video-editing-tools (video focus). The topic captures an independently surging vertical with its own market reports, regulatory events (EU AI Act Aug 2026), and investment cycles. Primary data gap: no publicly available market share breakdown by individual tool; shares estimated from proxy indicators (funding, user count, tool-ranking sites).
